notes: The html element carries no lang attribute, so assistive technology must guess the document language. Section 2.11 fires on the missing lang attribute itself. The document is otherwise a simple, operable page with no interaction, so the harm is mispronunciation and degraded reading for screen-reader users rather than task exclusion; per section 1.7 that degrades the experience for an affected group, making MEDIUM correct. The barrier is unambiguous.
